title: Scala Examples
description: Each example belongs to one starter lesson. Follow its setup steps before trying it. These examples need the named tools and do not run in this site playground.

examples.title: Print a greeting
examples.description: @main marks a starting function. println prints text.

examples.title: Keep a fixed value
examples.description: val names a value that cannot be reassigned.

examples.title: Build a message
examples.description: An s string can insert a variable with a dollar sign.

examples.title: Choose a result
examples.description: An if expression can return one of two values.
examples.code:
@main def lesson(): Unit =
  val score = 8
  val message = if score >= 5 then "Pass" else "Try again"
  println(message)

examples.title: Store a list
examples.description: List holds items in order. head reads the first item.

examples.title: Transform every item
examples.description: map builds a new list by applying a function to each item.

examples.title: Keep matching items
examples.description: filter keeps items for which its function returns true.

examples.title: Name a calculation
examples.description: def defines a function. Its input and return type are shown with colons.

examples.title: Handle an absent value
examples.description: Option holds Some(value) or None. getOrElse gives a fallback.

examples.title: Match a named choice
examples.description: match checks cases from top to bottom. _ is a catch-all case.
examples.code:
@main def lesson(): Unit =
  val light = "green"
  val message = light match
    case "red" => "Stop"
    case "green" => "Go"
    case _ => "Wait"
  println(message)

examples.title: Group data fields
examples.description: A case class is a handy data type with named fields and value-based equality.
examples.code:
@main def lesson(): Unit =
  case class Book(title: String, pages: Int)
  val book = Book("Moon Trip", 24)
  println(book.pages)

examples.title: Combine a list
examples.description: foldLeft starts with one value and combines it with each list item.
